jobs.occupation: Greenhouse & Berry Farm Workers – 2 Positions in Norway (Couple or Friends)
jobs.description:
We are looking for 2 motivated and responsible workers (a couple or two friends) to join a berry farm in Steinkjer, Norway. This is a mixed position combining hands-on farm work, berry picking and production management responsibilities. The farm mainly produces strawberries and raspberries in greenhouses.

Location: Steinkjer, Norway (Trondheim area)
Start Date: 10 March 2027
End Date: 20 October 2027

Job Responsibilities

• 
Planting and caring for strawberry and raspberry plants.

• 
Berry picking, harvesting and sorting fruits.

• 
Performing general greenhouse and farm work.

• 
Organising and planning daily greenhouse production.

• 
Supervising and coordinating approximately 13 seasonal berry pickers.

• 
Assigning tasks and checking workers' performance.

• 
Monitoring harvesting, production and quality.

• 
Assisting with cleaning, maintenance and other daily farm duties.

Important: This is a hands-on position. Both workers will participate in regular farm tasks, including berry picking, alongside their organisational and supervisory responsibilities.

Requirements

• 
Previous experience in greenhouse work, berry farming or agriculture is an advantage.

• 
Experience supervising workers is preferred.

• 
Good English communication skills.

• 
Responsible, organised, flexible and hardworking.

• 
At least one applicant must have a driving licence that allows them to operate a tractor.

• 
Willingness to perform both physical farm work and supervisory tasks.

• 
Couples or two friends applying together are welcome.

Salary and Accommodation

• 
Salary: 190–200 NOK per hour.

• 
Accommodation: Private apartment for two people.

• 
Rent: 150 NOK per day in total for both workers.

• 
Working period: 10 March – 20 October 2027.

• 
Possibility of approximately one week off during the season, depending on production needs.

How to Apply

Interested in seasonal farm work in Norway with your partner or a friend?

Send both CVs to apply@bixter.com

Do you want to play an important role in ensuring an efficient and flexible supply chain across our food processing factories? Are you able to navigate in a complex stakeholder landscape where totality is one of the essential key words? Would you like to join a team in development and help shape the direction of the future work? Then this position may be interesting to you.

About the job

We are looking for a dedicated and structured Master Planner to join our Processed Production team at the head office in Randers. We are an area in development, which means you’ll have a unique opportunity to shape the role and influence how we work going forward. You will play a key role in planning and coordinating production across our sites in Denmark, Germany and The Netherlands – with a focus on forecasting, capacity utilization, and network optimization.

Your key responsibilities are:

• Act as the central link between factory planners and demand planning to align production plans with demand forecasts.

• Consolidate capacity data from multiple sites and translate it into actionable production strategies.

• Be a key contributor in S&OE and S&OP forums to align operational execution with long-term strategic goals.

• Identify and resolve planning bottlenecks by balancing production loads across sites.

• Develop and maintain tools, such as capacity overviews, to enhance transparency and inform decision-making.

• Drive continuous improvement in planning processes, including network optimization and implementing best practices.

• Facilitate structured collaboration across departments to ensure alignment on priorities and constraints.

• Conduct scenario planning to model different production and supply chain outcomes and proactively mitigate risks such as raw material shortages or demand fluctuations.

• Leverage analytics and KPIs to support data-driven decision-making and improve planning accuracy and responsiveness.

• Maintain a strong understanding of the end-to-end supply chain, from raw material sourcing to finished goods delivery.

You take ownership of your projects

We seek a self-driven Master Planner to lead planning initiatives and enhance value by leveraging scale across our production network. You will oversee analysis, coordination, and implementation of improvements in your planning areas. A structured approach and stakeholder engagement are essential for ensuring alignment and commitment to solutions and changes.

Your ability to establish collaboration both inside and around your planning responsibilities and to influence functional teams throughout the organization is key for success in this role. Therefore, it is important that you can navigate and thrive in a complex stakeholder landscape, and that you apply your interpersonal skills to create meaningful relationships across the group.

The ideal candidate would:

• Have a relevant B.Sc or M.Sc degree within supply chain OR a strong background in supply chain management & planning, preferably within the food or manufacturing industry.

• Be skilled at translating complex data into clear, actionable plans and recommendations.

• A solid understanding of the end-to-end supply chain and how planning decisions impact each stage.

• Be Confidence working with Microsoft 365, particularly excel. Experience with planning systems (e.g. SAP APO, IBP, or similar) is considered an advantage.

• Be proactive and structured, with a natural ability to anticipate challenges and drive alignment across stakeholders.

• Thrive in a dynamic environment where priorities shift and collaboration across functions is key.

• Be fluent in Danish and English — knowledge of German is considered an advantage.

Appetite for more?

We are writing the next chapter for planning at Danish Crown and invite you to be part of it.

Please do not hesitate to contact Manager, Planning & Supply Chain Kamilla Hellerup, phone: +45 29893293 to learn more about the position.

We review candidates continuously, so send your CV and a few words on why you are a candidate to consider as soon as possible, as we reserve the right to stop the search once we have found the right candidate.

We look forward to hearing from you!

**THE OPPORTUNITY

**At Boozt, we are rethinking how we connect with our customers through data, personalisation, automation and AI. As our CRM setup continues to evolve, we are looking for a Marketing Automation Specialist who wants to help shape the next chapter.

This is an opportunity to take an active role in developing how we work with marketing automation at Boozt. You will join a team with ambitions to make our communication smarter, more relevant and more data-driven, with room to challenge existing approaches and explore how new technology can improve the way we work.

If you enjoy combining technical expertise with curiosity and a drive to make things better, this is your chance to make a real impact on how we do CRM at Boozt.

**What You Will Do

**You will be part of our CRM team, working hands-on with Salesforce Marketing Cloud to build and manage automated communications across email, app push and SMS. You will work closely with customer data to set up segmentation and personalisation, design targeted communications and continuously improve how we reach our customers.

**Your Main Responsibilities Will Include

**

• 
Build and manage automated communications and recurring campaigns in Salesforce Marketing Cloud (SFMC).

• 
Set up audience segmentation and personalisation using customer data, including SQL and AMPscript where relevant.

• 
Design and build personalised communications across email, app push and SMS.

• 
Analyse campaign performance, run A/B tests and use insights to improve results.

• 
Work closely with the CRM and market teams to ensure relevant communication across markets.

• 
Explore how AI and automation can improve the way we build, personalise and optimise customer communications.

**YOUR PROFILE

**You have hands-on experience with marketing automation and enjoy combining technical execution with analytical thinking and a curiosity for what is possible. You take ownership of your work, look for ways to improve and are comfortable exploring new approaches.

**We Imagine That You Bring

**

• 
Around 3 years of experience with marketing automation, preferably within CRM.

• 
Experience with a platform such as Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Braze, Adobe, Agillic, Voyado, Bloomreach or Klaviyo.

• 
A solid understanding of segmentation, personalisation, automated journeys and campaign testing.

• 
Experience working with campaign KPIs and using data to improve performance.

• 
An interest in AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude or Gemini and how they can support your daily work.

• 
Strong written communication skills and fluency in English.

Experience with SQL and AMPscript, as well as working across multiple markets, is a plus.

**WHY BOOZT

**At Boozt, you will join a fast-paced and ambitious environment where you have the freedom and responsibility to make a real impact. As part of our CRM team, you will work at the intersection of customer experience, data, technology and commercial growth. This approximately 14-month maternity cover is an opportunity to take ownership, explore new ideas and help shape the customer experience for millions of customers while developing your skills in e-commerce CRM.

**Apply today – we’re excited to learn more about you!

_Only applications submitted in English will be considered.

_Important: Applicants must have the legal right to work in Denmark at the time of employment. Please note that this position does not include visa sponsorship or relocation support.

We review applications on an ongoing basis. You can read more about the process under **Recruitment.

****BOOZT PERKS

**

• 
Great personal and internal career development opportunities

• 
A culture built on our values of trust, freedom, and responsibility

• 
Driven and passionate international colleagues

• 
A generous employee discount

• 
Healthy and delicious breakfast and lunch, top-quality coffee, and fresh fruit available all day

• 
In-house gym, onsite masseuse, and medical doctor

• 
An amazing HQ in central Copenhagen – the iconic, energy-efficient Krystallen building, recognized for its architectural design and sustainability. Enjoy breathtaking city views and much more!

jobs.occupation: Functional Solution Architect / Senior Consultant – D365 Finance & Operations
jobs.description:
Are you a passionate Finance Consultant with experience in Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations? Then we offer you the opportunity for a unique position with exciting projects, great colleagues, excellent facilities, and the chance to develop your skills while contributing to our continued success at Cepheo.

At Cepheo, we take pride in having many talented employees across the Nordics who are dedicated to working with the entire Microsoft Dynamics platform. We’re excited to say that, due to new international projects, we now have room for more talented colleagues to join our team.

The Finance & Operations team covers a wide range of industries, including manufacturing, construction, utilities and energy, wholesale, and retail. For this position, your primary focus will be on our manufacturing clients. Therefore, knowledge of this segment is an advantage - but not a requirement - as your expertise in financial processes within D365FO is what truly matters.

About Cepheo

Cepheo empowers businesses to adapt and succeed in a changing world. With locations across the Nordics and decades of experience in implementing and developing industry-specific solutions based on the Microsoft platform, we help our customers use technology and data to make more informed decisions, optimize daily operations, and bring out the best in their people.

In Denmark, Cepheo has offices across the country, and you can choose the location that suits you best. We have offices in Copenhagen, Aarhus, Aalborg, Thisted, and Kolding, with a total of 110 employees fully focused on Microsoft Dynamics solutions. The largest business area in Denmark - and across the entire group - is Finance & Operations. In addition to close collaboration with our sister companies in Norway and Sweden, we also work closely with Cepheo Poland, our nearshore center with around 100 employees.

After two years of establishing Cepheo as a strong new brand in the Dynamics market, we are now ready to accelerate our growth. The foundation is in place with new and ongoing large international projects.

As a consultant at Cepheo, you are allocated 10% of your time for skills development - and we can ensure you that we walk the talk. We can document that we meet this goal, and we view education as an investment that makes us stronger - we do not see it as a cost.

About the position

As a Functional Solution Architect / Senior Consultant, you will be part of a strong team focused on ERP processes, working across the entire Dynamics platform - especially F&O, but also the Power Platform. We value learning from each other and taking shared responsibility. We believe this broad collaboration is essential for continuous professional development, which is why Cepheo dedicates time and resources to training and knowledge sharing.

You’ll join a team of skilled and highly experienced D365FO consultants, ensuring high-level sparring. You’ll also experience a fast pace environment, as you’ll be involved in new projects from the early stages, helping to set the scene. You’ll work closely with Cepheo’s other F&O teams (Project Management, Service Delivery Managers, Developers - both Danish and Polish colleagues - and infrastructure technicians).

As an architect within the finance area, you’ll carry significant responsibility in the project. You’ll challenge the customer on process optimization within your area of expertise and coordinate with colleagues handling other workstreams to ensure cohesion. We know that all issues in the various business areas eventually impact finance, so you’ll play a key role in mitigating potential challenges. Familiarity (not deep expertise) with other process areas such as procurement, sales, inventory, and production is essential for success in the role.

You’ll be introduced to Cepheo’s implementation model, which is based on a well-documented process framework. You’ll find that Cepheo is at the forefront of process-oriented approaches, and your tasks will reflect that.

You’ll also have the opportunity to join our Nordic Capability Group for Finance & Operations, giving you a network with colleagues in Scandinavia and Poland, where you can share knowledge and learn from others that works in the same field as you.

Who are you?

We expect that you have several years of experience as a consultant within D365FO solutions, preferably with experience in financial solutions for manufacturing clients.

Additionally, we expect you to have experience with relevant third-party financial solutions such as AMC Banking, SK Global, and Exflow. Experience with international projects is also an advantage. At Cepheo, you’ll take ownership of how projects are delivered. You’ll work closely with customers and typically be involved from the analysis phase through implementation and ongoing support and development.

We value quality and expect you to be a strong communicator in both Danish and English. It’s also a plus if you are naturally proactive, curious, structured, and possess strong business acumen.

We’re looking for a colleague with several of the following competencies:

• Experienced D365FO consultant within the finance domain

• Industry knowledge in the manufacturing domain

• Solid experience within Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations

• Understanding of functionality related to sales, purchasing, logistics, etc., enabling you to advise on the connection between the value chain and the finance department, including reconciliation with inventory, costing, etc.

• Familiarity with finance-related add-on solutions

• Strong experience in designing standard solutions

• A customer oriented mindset and a naturally service-minded approach

• Comfortable working independently as well as part of a strong team

• A strong drive and eagerness to learn and be challenged

• Strong analytical and communication skills

Interested?

If you have any questions about the position or would like to know more, feel free to contact us. You can reach out to our Director of F&O, Uffe Pallesen, through uffe.pallesen@cepheo.com or phone 52 18 53 35. We are conducting interviews on an ongoing basis and are looking to hire a permanent employee. We look forward to hearing from you.

**Join us to Make an Impact

**Innovation is in our DNA. We invented supercontinuum lasers and photonic crystal fibers and we constantly reimagine how our products can be used and improved. Our customers use our products in medical and life science research, quantum computing and space exploration.

We seek curious, creative and collaborative people to work in our cutting-edge company. Can you see yourself working in teams and providing solutions for innovators?

If you wish to apply, please contact us with your CV / Résumé. If you have a cover letter, please save this in one document with your CV / Résumé as you are only able to upload one document.

We look forward to hearing from you!

**About The Role

**We are looking for a Project Manager to join our New Product Introduction (NPI) team.

As Project Manager in NPI you will work closely together with optical, electrical, mechanical and software engineers on maturing design and developing assembly and test processes. When the project has proven the product can be manufactured with satisfactory yield, it will be transferred to Operations, freeing up space and resources for the new next project.

**What You Will Do

**

• Lead maturation and transfer projects of laser products.

• Be responsible for planning resource alignment, risk and change management, project reporting, and follow-up the gate process to ensure projects are delivered within scope, on time, and within budget.

**What You Bring

**To succeed in this role, you should have a technical background in one or more of the following areas: optics/photonics, electronics, or production engineering.

**Essential

**

• Demonstrated experience delivering complex technical projects, ideally related to product development, product maturation, or technology transfer.

• Ability to effectively lead technical specialists and facilitate project meetings, design reviews, and key decision-making processes.

• Experience working in a manufacturing environment.

• Communicate fluently in English and thrive in cross-functional, international teams.

**What We Offer

**We want you to feel supported, both at work and outside it. Our benefits include:

• A 12% employer-paid pension contribution and health insurance.

• An annual bonus programme.

• 25 days of paid vacation, plus five additional days once you have been with us for nine months.

• Access to thousands of courses through LinkedIn Learning.

• Wellbeing initiatives and an annual flu vaccination.

• Freshly prepared meals from our subsidised on-site canteen.

• Free parking at our Birkerød site.

• Social activities through our Employee Association.

_Benefits are subject to eligibility and the relevant plan or policy terms.

_**Practical Information

**

• Working arrangement: On site

• Working language: English

• Employment: Full time

**Keep your personal data safe

**Hamamatsu ("The Company") take responsibly for the protection of your personal data. Accordingly, upon receiving your job application and additional material you choose to submit, the Company keeps a safe and secure environment and ensures confidentiality.

You also have a role to play in keeping your personal data safe. We request you only submit personal data about yourself in your job application, CV / Résumé or other relevant material you choose to provide to us that is relevant for the specific job opening you are applying for.

Please consider whether there is personal information you are about to submit, such as health information, information on family relations, information on trade union membership, etc. that is not necessary for our recruitment process or the job opening you are applying for. Please also be aware that certificates or other documents are not necessary for the vacancy. We urgently request you to redact/cross out such information before you submit your job application.

Thank you.

Kassow Robots is a Danish company that develops and manufactures unique 7-axis collaborative robots for a wide range of industrial applications. Since 2022, we have been part of Bosch Rexroth, a leading global automation company within the Bosch Group.

Are you passionate about cutting-edge technology and hands-on problem solving? In our Assembly and Repair Department, you will take on an important role, working with colleagues to assemble, repair, and improve complete robot systems.

At our young technology company, you will join a diverse and dedicated team of passionate colleagues who make a real difference every day. You’ll experience a dynamic work environment where collaboration, innovation, and quality are at the heart of everything we do.

Your Primary Responsibilities

• Inspect, analyze, and troubleshoot robotic systems and equipment

• Read repair manuals and collaborate with engineers and other specialists

• Run tests, interpret results, and provide effective recommendations

• Write reports, safety regulations, and preventative maintenance plans

• Source and replace faulty parts and components

• Perform both mechanical and electrical assembly of robot systems

• Support manufacturing and development engineers in ongoing projects

• Handle service requests via our support system

• Stay up to date with advancements in the field and attend workshops as needed

What We’re Looking For

• Practical experience with installation, repair, and troubleshooting of complex systems, ideally including electronics and cabling

• Strong problem-solving skills and ability to learn quickly

• A quality-conscious, systematic, and hands-on approach to work

• Ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously and thrive in a dynamic environment

• Excellent team player with strong communication skills

• A customer-oriented mindset with a focus on delivering reliable solutions

What We Offer

• Comprehensive training in our robot systems and installations

• A collaborative and innovative work environment in a growing tech company

• Opportunity to work with state-of-the-art robotics

• Personal and professional development through workshops and knowledge sharing

• A role where your contributions directly impact the company’s success

📍 Workplace: All work takes place at our company headquarters in Kastrup.

Corti builds AI for critical industries. We started in healthcare, where messy inputs, specialized knowledge, and consequential errors make demanding engineering problems unavoidable. Today we train and post-train models, build agents, and turn research into APIs that developers use to build their products. Our platform supports more than one million production interactions every week.

We are building Europe’s alternative to closed AI: ambitious model development, published research, and AI infrastructure that gives developers control over the systems they depend on.

Our platform and APIs provide the building blocks for specialized intelligence that organizations own:

• 
Models: frontier and open-weight models with reasoning, tool calling, structured output, and embeddings through an OpenAI-compatible interface, plus custom models trained and post-trained on an organization’s own data.

• 
Sovereign compute: GPU capacity on Corti-operated European infrastructure for teams that need their data and workloads to stay in Europe.

• 
Agents: a harness to build, evaluate, and optimize agents that connect to real systems, with planning, tool use, external knowledge, persistent context, human approval, and observable execution.

• 
Speech: live dictation, conversational transcription, and batch audio processing.

• 
Clinical documentation: fact extraction as conversations unfold, and document generation with explicit schemas and controllable synthesis.

• 
Medical coding: code predictions from clinical narratives, linked to supporting passages.

Explore the platform at docs.corti.ai.

The Role

We’re looking for a GTM Engineer to help build the systems behind a smarter, more scalable go-to-market engine at Corti. You’ll connect the tools and data that power our commercial teams, turning fragmented systems into a reliable foundation for automation, insight, and action.

This is a hands-on engineering role for someone who enjoys working at the intersection of software, data, and business impact. You’ll partner closely with Growth, Sales, DevEx Growth, and Platform to design workflows, improve data quality, and build the internal products and automations that help us move faster as we scale.

What you'll do

Data foundation

• 
Build and maintain the integrated data layer across Corti’s commercial data systems, bringing together data from tools such as Stripe, Attio, Supabase, Calendly, and Leexi.

• 
Own the event tracking layer, instrumenting key product and commercial touchpoints so analytics tools (PostHog, Mixpanel, etc.) reflect what's actually happening.

• 
Build enrichment pipelines that pull from third-party data providers and internal signals to keep ICP records current and scored.

Systems and automation

• 
Design and implement workflows, automations, and backend services that improve how commercial teams operate, from pipeline management and deal acceleration to post-sale handoffs.

• 
Identify repetitive GTM processes and systematically eliminate them through automation, freeing commercial teams to focus on higher-judgment work.

Activation and tooling

• 
Build systems that surface timely signals and enable proactive, data-driven GTM execution, including AI-powered internal tools and agentic workflows where appropriate.

• 
Build internal tools that reduce manual work for sales, CS, and growth, such as automated account research, meeting prep summaries, or usage-based alert systems.

• 
Partner with Growth and RevOps to define the data models and pipeline logic that underpin campaign targeting, segmentation, and attribution.

Cross-functional impact

• 
Collaborate as the primary technical builder for GTM teams across Growth, Enterprise Sales, Developer Experience, and Scaled Customer Experience, translating process needs into robust, scalable solutions.

• 
Document all built components so systems remain understandable and extensible as the team scales.

• 
Contribute to engineering quality through clean implementation, thoughtful code review, and cross-functional collaboration.

What you bring

• 
Experience as a software engineer, ideally at mid-level, with exposure to growth, sales, or other go-to-market teams.

• 
Strong proficiency in Node.js and TypeScript, with a backend or server-side engineering focus.

• 
Experience integrating business-critical tools such as HubSpot, Salesforce, Pipedrive, or similar systems.

• 
Familiarity with analytics and data tooling such as PostHog, Mixpanel, Segment, Google Analytics, Amplitude, or Google Tag Manager.

• 
Experience working with ETL processes, data synchronization, or workflow automation is a plus, but not required.

• 
Excellent English verbal and written communication skills, including all-remote communication.

Life at Corti

• 
You will be reporting to VP of Growth

• 
The position is full-time and starts as soon as possible.

• 
Hybrid working environment in Copenhagen

• 
Equipment provided by Corti

________________________________________________________________

We treat all candidates equally, are committed to bringing in top talent from all sectors and countries, and will not discriminate based on race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, or disability status.

Additionally, we want to remind you that experience comes in many forms, and we're passionate about creating teams with a multitude of perspectives! If you believe your experience is close to what we're looking for but not an exact match, we still hope you consider applying!

jobs.occupation: Product Owner – Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central
jobs.description:
Would you like to take ownership of a central Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central solution?

Conscia are looking for an experienced Product Owner who can take end-to-end ownership of the Business Central solution and act as the link between the business, IT and external vendors.

You will have a central role in both the ongoing development of the solution and its future roadmap.

Your responsibilities

• Own and prioritize the technical product backlog

• Translate business requirements into user stories and technical solutions

• Act as the link between Finance, Sales, IT and external vendors

• Coordinate releases and upgrades from Microsoft and vendors

• Coordinate business testing following new releases

• Take responsibility for local integrations between Business Central and other systems

• Work closely with developers and technical teams

• Identify technical risks and dependencies

• Contribute to the Business Central roadmap and future development

• Ensure relevant documentation of the solution and system landscape

We are looking for someone who has

• Solid experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central

• Good understanding of ERP and Finance processes

• Experience with integrations such as REST APIs, web services and Azure

• Understanding of data flows, data models and cloud architecture

• Experience with backlog management, prioritization and release management

• Ability to translate business needs into technical solutions

• Experience with Azure DevOps or similar tools

• Experience with Power BI is an advantage

• Fluent in both Danish and English

You do not need to be a developer, but you need to be technically strong enough to understand solutions, integrations and the dialogue with developers.

About you

You naturally take ownership and enjoy creating alignment between different stakeholders.

You communicate clearly with both business and technical specialists and are comfortable coordinating multiple stakeholders and vendors.

Most importantly, you are able to understand business needs while also asking the right technical questions.

Interested?

If you have strong Business Central experience and would like a role where you can take real ownership and influence the development of a central business solution, we would love to hear from you.

Contact: Pauline Christiansen, Senior Client Executive, EPICO Group, +45 53 74 71 53, Email: pac@epico.dk

EPICO is the recruitment partner for Conscia Group on this position.

About Conscia

Conscia is a leading European provider of IT security and business-critical IT infrastructure, delivering solutions from Cisco, Palo Alto, VMware, Microsoft Azure, and a wide range of other technology partners.

Conscia has a strong focus on advanced cybersecurity, including security monitoring, detection and incident response, compliance, and the protection of complex and regulated IT environments.

The ambition is to be the preferred partner for organisations with critical IT infrastructure throughout the entire lifecycle – from strategic consulting and architecture design to implementation, operations, and continuous optimisation.

Conscia employs more than 1,500 people and is represented in Denmark, Sweden, Norway, Germany, the Netherlands, Belgium, the United Kingdom, Ireland, Finland, and Slovenia.

jobs.description:
Join an International Transformation Program at Scan Global Logistics

Are you detail-oriented, analytical, and passionate about working with data? Do you enjoy identifying errors, improving data quality, and ensuring that information is accurate and ready for use?

Scan Global Logistics is looking for a Data Migration Specialist to join its migration team and support an international transformation program. You will play an important role in migrating data between existing applications, ensuring high data quality and supporting successful system implementations across multiple countries.

You do not need to be an expert in a specific ERP platform. What matters most is your practical experience with data migration, your Excel skills, and your ability to spot inconsistencies and solve data-related problems.

Your role

You will become part of a close-knit team that works together to ensure successful data migrations and regular go-lives. The team values collaboration, knowledge sharing, and helping each other succeed.

Your main responsibility will be to work hands-on with data, from analysing existing datasets to validating migrated data and identifying issues that need to be resolved.

Key responsibilities

• Support data migration between existing applications and new systems.

• Analyse and validate data using Excel to ensure accuracy and completeness.

• Identify errors, duplicates, missing information, and data inconsistencies.

• Perform data cleansing, reconciliation, and quality checks.

• Investigate discrepancies and coordinate their resolution with relevant stakeholders.

• Ensure data is ready for testing, migration, and go-live.

• Collaborate with colleagues and stakeholders across different countries.

• Contribute to improving data migration processes and working methods.

What we are looking for

• Practical experience with data migration between systems or applications.

• Strong Excel skills and confidence working with large datasets.

• A structured and detail-oriented approach to analysing data.

• Experience identifying data errors and ensuring data quality.

• An analytical mindset and the ability to investigate and resolve discrepancies.

• Good communication skills and the ability to collaborate with different stakeholders.

• A proactive attitude and the ability to take ownership of your tasks.

• A willingness to share knowledge, ask questions, and learn from colleagues.

Experience with ERP systems, such as Microsoft Dynamics 365, SAP, or Oracle, is an advantage but not a requirement. Experience with SQL, data analysis tools, testing, or go-live activities is also beneficial.

What you can expect

• An opportunity to contribute to a large international transformation program.

• A supportive team where colleagues share knowledge and help each other.

• A varied role with regular go-lives and practical data challenges.

• Collaboration with colleagues and stakeholders across multiple countries.

• The opportunity to contribute to smarter and more automated ways of working, including the use of AI.

About you

You are curious, methodical, and comfortable working with details. You enjoy getting to the bottom of data issues and take pride in delivering accurate, high-quality work.

Do you have a strong interest in cyber security and enjoy turning new insights and knowledge into ways of improvement? At Collectia, we are looking for a hands-on security professional with the ability to work across a broad technical remit and help move our security programme forward.

In this role, you will be the main contributor across a range of cyber security initiatives, working closely with experienced colleagues in DevOps, Engineering and IT Support, as well as external specialists. The position covers infrastructure, cloud, identity, endpoints and operational processes, combining technical security engineering with governance and compliance. You will help define effective controls and make sure they are implemented in practice.

Your key responsibilities

• Own and continuously develop our CIS 18 framework, including gap assessments, prioritised action plans, implementation follow-up and maturity reporting.

• Support the handling of security incidents, including investigation, containment, lessons learned and improvements to controls, monitoring and procedures.

Security domains in scope

The role spans identity and privileged access management, multifactor authentication, vulnerability management, logging and detection, incident management, endpoint and network security, server hardening, and cloud security across Microsoft 365 and Azure. It also includes security controls, risk management and audit readiness.

You will be part of

You will join our DevOps department in a role with significant influence on how security is designed, implemented and operated. We are open to different levels of experience. If you are earlier in your cyber security career but have a strong technical foundation, the right mindset and the ambition to grow into broader ownership, we would still be very interested in hearing from you.

Experience with control frameworks such as CIS 18, and with audit preparation or remediation in an ISAE 3000, ISO 27001, NIS2 or similar environment is an advantage.

We are seeking an early-career RF Engineer to contribute to the design, development and validation of RF communication subsystems for nanosatellite missions.

In this role, you will support RF analysis and integration activities across UHF, VHF, S-band and X-band systems, perform link-budget analyses and help validate performance through hardware-in-the-loop and over-the-air testing.

You will join our Satellite Systems Hardware team in Aalborg and collaborate closely with colleagues across RF, Hardware, and Systems Engineering. You will work with GomSpace’s flight-proven NanoCom radios and SDR platform and gain practical experience across simulation, laboratory testing and system-level integration. Depending on the mission, you may contribute to conventional communication subsystems, software-defined radio applications or advanced RF sensing payloads.

Your Role

As RF Engineer, you will support the development and validation of RF subsystems for satellite missions, from link-budget analysis and RF-chain modelling through integration, hardware-in-the-loop testing and over-the-air validation.

Working with experienced engineers, you will gradually build the knowledge and practical experience needed to take responsibility for increasingly complex RF engineering tasks.

Your key responsibilities include:

• Support RF subsystem analysis and technical trade-offs across frequency bands, performance and mission constraints.

• Perform link-budget analysis and RF-chain modelling.

• Contribute to the definition and documentation of RF subsystem requirements and interfaces.

• Support the integration, verification and validation of RF subsystems, including hardware-in-the-loop and over-the-air testing.

• Assist with the evaluation and selection of RF front-end components across UHF, VHF, S-band and X-band.

• Prepare and carry out laboratory measurements using RF test equipment.

• Analyse test results and contribute to troubleshooting RF performance issues.

• Contribute to onboard signal-processing and data-reduction activities for RF applications.

• Document analyses, test activities and technical conclusions clearly and systematically.

• Provide technical input to mission proposals with support from experienced colleagues.

What Success Looks Like

In the initial phase, success means:

• Understanding GomSpace’s NanoCom product portfolio and SDR architecture.

• Building effective working relationships with colleagues across RF, Hardware and Systems Engineering.

• Completing a link-budget analysis for an active mission with guidance from experienced colleagues.

• Performing your first hardware-in-the-loop or over-the-air RF test using GomSpace equipment.

• Documenting your analysis and test results in a clear and structured way.

• Communicating RF results and technical observations clearly to colleagues from other disciplines.

Over time, you will take increasing responsibility for RF subsystem analysis, integration and verification activities. You will contribute independently to mission proposals and projects while helping develop reusable RF models, test methods and engineering tools.

What You Bring

You are a recent graduate or early-career RF engineer who is motivated to apply your technical knowledge to real satellite systems. You enjoy combining analytical work with practical laboratory activities and want to develop your skills within an experienced multidisciplinary team.

You likely bring:

• An MSc in Electrical Engineering, RF or Microwave Engineering, Telecommunications or a related field.

• Up to one year of relevant experience in RF engineering, communication systems, testing or integration.

• A basic understanding of RF engineering principles and communication systems.

• Experience with RF analysis, simulation or laboratory measurements gained through your studies, thesis, student employment, internship or first professional role.

• Familiarity with RF simulation or engineering tools such as CST, ADS, HFSS, MATLAB, Python or similar.

• Some experience with RF test equipment, such as spectrum analysers, vector network analysers or signal generators.

• An interest in satellite communication systems, software-defined radio or digital signal processing.

• Good analytical and problem-solving skills.

• Good written and spoken English.

Experience from the space or aerospace industry is an advantage but is not required. Relevant academic projects, thesis work, internships and student positions will also be considered.

Knowledge of modulation schemes, communication protocols, RF payloads, ECSS standards or space-grade RF qualification would be beneficial.

Who You Are

You are curious, systematic and motivated by the opportunity to turn engineering analysis into working hardware. You enjoy learning from experienced colleagues while also taking responsibility for your own tasks and development.

You are known for:

• Technical curiosity – eager to understand how RF systems perform in practice.

• Attention to detail – careful when analysing results, conducting tests and documenting conclusions.

• Hands-on problem solving – interested in moving between simulation tools and the laboratory bench.

• Collaborative communication – comfortable working with RF, systems, payload and hardware engineers.

• Structured execution – able to plan your work, follow up on tasks and communicate when support is needed.

• Customer focus – understanding that good engineering contributes directly to the success of our customers’ missions.

• Willingness to grow – open to feedback and motivated to build deeper RF subsystem expertise.

Why Join Us

You will have the opportunity to begin or develop your RF engineering career by working on communication systems for real nanosatellite missions.

The position offers hands-on experience across RF analysis, laboratory testing and system-level integration. You will work with flight-proven NanoCom radios and SDR platforms while learning from experienced specialists across RF, Hardware, and Systems Engineering.

Your work will contribute to mission proposals, subsystem development and technologies that ultimately fly in space. As your experience develops, you will take on increasing technical responsibility and have the opportunity to shape the tools and methods used by the team.
